chapters.title: The Problem & The Idea
chapters.description: Money disappears before you can save it. MutualPool puts a tradition communities have trusted for generations to work for gig and trade workers.

chapters.title: How a Pod Works
chapters.description: Everyone puts in the same amount each week. One member receives the whole pot. The order is set when the pod locks.
chapters.highlight: No interest • No credit check • No loan

chapters.title: Money, Fees & Rules
chapters.description: Deposits every Thursday, payouts every Friday, simple fees, and rules that protect the members who keep paying.
chapters.highlight: 5% per deposit • 10% per payout, 3% to the host

chapters.title: Perks & Paid Campaigns
chapters.description: Road perks from partners who get gig life, brand campaigns that pay you by the day, and Lainie to answer questions any time.
chapters.highlight: Meals • Repairs • Phone plans • Sponsored hoodies
